fields.Name: R3 -> S1.4
fields.Description: Gate G1.8 (phase 1, dataset R3, criterion S1.4): the R3 Poisson count target declared continuous is refused with task-type-mismatch, and the same target declared count trains to a Completed run. It fails when the unit target validation drops the rule that a count-shaped target cannot be declared continuous, so the Poisson target is accepted as continuous.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Declared continuous: refused with task-type-mismatch; declared count: the run completes.
